description: This file defines the ConfigHelper class within the OrangeHRM system, which is responsible for managing configuration paths, reading plugin configurations, client configurations, and global settings. It provides methods to gather various configuration details and is integral to the application's setup process.

classes.name: OrangeHRM\Config\ConfigHelper
classes.description: A class that handles configuration paths, plugin configurations, client settings, and global system settings for the OrangeHRM application.

methods.name: getPathConfigs
methods.description: Retrieves and constructs an array of essential directory paths used by the system, such as base, source, plugin, web, proxy, test, log, cache, config, cryptokeys, session, and config file path.

methods.name: getPluginConfigs
methods.description: Scans the plugins directory for plugin folders ending with 'Plugin' and loads their configurations if available.

methods.name: getPluginConfiguration
methods.description: Given a plugin directory, scans for the plugin configuration PHP file and returns its metadata as an array.

methods.name: getClientConfigs
methods.description: Returns client-related configuration paths, including the client directory, template directory, Vue build directory, and build timestamp.

methods.name: getGlobalConfigs
methods.description: Provides global system configurations such as internationalization, date formatting, and session timeout settings.

methods.name: getConfigs
methods.description: Aggregates all configuration arrays into a single comprehensive configuration array.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a specific configuration value by name with optional default if not set.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Returns the entire current configuration array.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Merges new configuration parameters into the existing configuration array.
